info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Regions-v1-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Regions API provides access to a list of geographic regions for weather alerts. It enables users to retrieve detailed information about areas that are affected by various weather notifications. This API is crucial for developers building applications that require up-to-date weather information for risk management, safety, and planning purposes. Typical consumers include meteorological services, mobile applications, and emergency response systems that aim to keep users informed about weather-related events.

get.summary: Retrieve alerts for a specific region
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all alerts corresponding to a specified region. Useful for monitoring and responding to region-specific conditions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary input parameters for retrieving alerts associated with a specific region. The structure of the input should conform to the defined schema, which outlines the required and optional fields to correctly format the request.

200.description: The request was successful and alerts for the specified region are returned.
